text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Explains law, liability, and public safety concerns","quality":"argument development","description":"The essay builds a more complete case by addressing not just benefits but also the practical obstacles and consequences of driverless cars."},{"evidence":"Uses several article points across multiple paragraphs","quality":"support integration","description":"The essay weaves in more source-based details in a way that makes its argument feel better supported and less dependent on unsupported generalizations."},{"evidence":"Moves from benefits to problems to future prospects","quality":"organization","description":"The essay has a clearer progression of ideas that helps the reader follow the argument from one point to the next."},{"evidence":"Connects driver alertness to texting and boredom","quality":"reasoned elaboration","description":"The essay more often explains why a detail matters, rather than merely stating it, which strengthens the logic of the argument."},{"evidence":"Few major sentence-level breakdowns","quality":"control of expression","description":"Although it has errors, the prose is generally easier to understand and less interrupted by unclear phrasing than the other essay."}]}
